name: apliiq-mcp
description: Apliiq (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order, track. Every tool maps to a

platform_mcp_apliiq_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APLIIQ_APP_ID
platform_mcp_apliiq_app_id.description: API Key (APPID) of an Apliiq custom store (https://www.apliiq.com/verified/stores > custom store > API Key).

platform_mcp_apliiq_shared_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APLIIQ_SHARED_SECRET
platform_mcp_apliiq_shared_secret.description: The store's Shared_SECRET: signs every request (base64 HMAC-SHA256 over APPID + RTS + STATE + base64(body), empty for GET). Never sent on the wire.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Apliiq has no account endpoint; the probe lists the last month's orders (an array), so `account` is empty on success. A 401 means the APPID/Shared_SECRET signature was refused.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /v1/Product returns the whole blank catalogue as one array [{Id, Name, Code, SKU, Price, Currency_Code, Sizes[{Id, Name, Weight, PlusSize_Fee}], Colors[{Id, Name}], Services, Locations}]; `query`, `category`, `page` and `limit` are not accepted by the endpoint.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One blank product by its numeric Id with Sizes, Colors, Services (screen print, embroidery, digital print ...), Locations (placement areas) and Subscriptions in `raw`.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /v1/Order/{OrderId} answers a one-element array [{OrderId, OrderDate, ExpectedDate, TotalQty, SN[shipment notices], StoreOrderId, Status (New, In Production, Ready To Ship, Shipped, Canceled, ...), AwaitingGarment, AwaitingArtwork, CanChangeShipAddress}]. No totals are returned.

tools.name: track
tools.description: The order's shipment notices SN[{TrackingNumber, Service (e.g. USPS First Class Mail), Carrier (tracking URL), Helptext ("your package shipped on ..."), Items}]; empty until shipped.
